note: Where every makeyourmindup brand asset lives. Read this before fetching any logo, colour, font, photo, template, sting, character pose, music or channel art. Prefer the Drive id: ids survive moves, paths do not. Krish asked for one canonical brand kit on 11 Nov 2026 (docs/BRAND-KIT.md). The Canva kit itself is social/brand/kit.json.

canonical_kit.name: 1 Brand kit (permanent)
canonical_kit.source_of_truth: krishanraja/makeyourmindup (apps/cover, docs/brandbooknew). Where a file here and that repository disagree, the repository wins.

brand_book.use: The rules: name, logo, colour, type, sections, photography, voice. Start here.

brand_book_components.use: 43-page component and token reference (27 Oct 2026): buttons, stickers, stamps, diagrams, contrast pairs, every token.
brand_book_components.caveat: Its page 4 puts under.the.hood on Monday and follow.the.money on Wednesday. That is wrong. follow.the.money is Monday, under.the.hood Wednesday, mind.the.gap Friday. The colours are right: butter follow.the.money, lilac under.the.hood, coral mind.the.gap.

logos.use: Stacked for covers and first screens, horizontal for nav, footers and email headers, mark for avatars and favicons. The logo only sits on ink.

colours.use: palette.txt: every colour with hex, RGB and its one job. Same values as social/brand/kit.json and render/kit.css.

tokens.use: tokens.css, tokens.json, tailwind.preset.cjs for anything built on screen.

fonts.use: Anton (headings), Fraunces italic (the human line), Archivo (body), IBM Plex Mono (labels), each with its SIL OFL licence. Vendored here at render/fonts.

photography.use: The felt robot lying down (cover) and standing (welcome), as sources and cut onto ink; editor/ holds Krish's two photos.

applications.use: Finished examples: social card 1200x630, Substack cover and wordmark, email banner, signature banner, site screenshots.

templates.use: Editable PowerPoint starters: social post, ad, deck. Replace sample text before use. Canva templates are in social/brand/kit.json.

design_system.use: The Claude Design System package (8 Oct 2026): makeyourmindup.tokens.json, makeyourmindup-Brand-system.md, the two-part zip and MIGRATE.md to rebuild it in another account.

intro_sting.use: One sting per section in 16x9 and 9x16. content-engine config/intro-sting.json reads these by path; do not move or rename.

character.use: Krish's cartoon character: base, poses, contact sheet, manifest. content-engine config/ve/character.json reads it by path; do not move or rename. Not approved for use until that file says approved.

music.use: The one home for licensed Epidemic Sound beds (content-engine runtime.music_root and config/music-library.json). File new tracks here and nowhere else.

channel_art.use: YouTube banner and watermark, profile pictures, Facebook cover, X header, Instagram highlight covers, bios. READ ME - profiles.txt says which file goes where.

canva_kit.use: The Canva brand kit and growth templates. Ids and sizes in social/brand/kit.json.

inspiration.use: Reference clips for production quality. Studied, never published, never part of the brand kit.

style_references_mirror.use: A mirror of Production Inspo the engine fills (content-engine references.py). Never file a clip here by hand, never publish one.

not_canonical.note: Since 11 Nov 2026 there is one brand folder. 00_Brand-Assets and every old copy (kit v1.5 duplicate, old channel art, launch exports, old Canva links, frozen video formats) were deleted to the Drive bin on Krish's instruction. Nothing else holds brand.
